title: 第三章 佩戴戒入宗门第四章 山门被刁难怒踹守门人
slug: 震惊五星灵帝被逼着撩妹
lines: 杨卤看着手中的返老还童丹，脸色比吃了苍蝇还难看。
他活了四百七十六年，五星灵帝大圆满，整个西南域谁见了不得跪着喊一声“灵帝大人”？结果现在，一个不知道从哪冒出来的系统，逼着他吃一颗什么返老还童丹？
这玩意儿听着就不靠谱。
“系统，你确定这丹药没问题？”杨卤在心里问道，“吃完不会拉肚子吧？不会有什么副作用吧？不会变不回来吧？”
系统没有回应。
杨卤又等了一会儿，确认系统真的不打算搭理他之后，咬了咬牙，把丹药扔进了嘴里。
丹药入口即化，一股清凉的药力顺着喉咙滑入体内，然后迅速扩散到四肢百骸。
杨卤感觉到自己的骨骼在发出轻微的“咔咔”声，肌肉在收缩，皮肤在紧致，就连他那留了三百年的胡子，都在以肉眼可见的速度脱落。
杨卤低头看着自己那双原本布满老茧和皱纹的手，此刻正在变得光滑、白皙、年轻。
他赶紧跑到城墙边上，对着城墙上的水迹看了看自己的倒影——
一张十八岁的脸。
剑眉星目，棱角分明，皮肤白嫩得能掐出水来。
杨卤愣在原地，看了好半天，才缓缓吐出一口气：“这是年轻时候的我啊……”
他穿越过来的时候，就是这副模样。
后来经历了无数战斗，脸上多了风霜，身上多了伤疤，才变成了那个威严的五星灵帝。
现在倒好，一朝回到解放前。
【任务完成！】
【正在结算奖励……】
【气息压制戒指x1（已发放）】
系统提示音响起的同时，杨卤手中多了一枚黑色的戒指。
戒指通体乌黑，没有任何花纹，看起来就像个普通的铁环。
杨卤把戒指戴在左手无名指上，一道信息立刻涌入他的脑海——
【气息压制戒指（五星灵器）】
【功能：佩戴后，将佩戴者的全部实力气息压制至二星灵王入灵境，不影响实际战力】
【备注：该戒指无法被任何低于五星级的探查术法识破，高于五星级的存在可察觉端倪】
杨卤看完介绍，眉头微微一挑。
这玩意儿有点意思。
他尝试运转了一下体内的星力，果然，周身散发的气息就固定在二星灵王入灵境，哪怕他自己刻意释放，也冲不破这个上限。
但真正动手的时候，他的五星灵帝实力一点都没少。
“隐藏实力的好东西。”杨卤点了点头，“就是不知道系统又要搞什么幺蛾子……”
他话音未落，系统提示音再次响起——
【新任务已解锁！】
【1.佩戴气息压制戒指，前往灵黔峰管辖范围内的“星澜宗”，以普通内门弟子的身份拜入宗门】
【2.扣除自身5000许愿值】
【3.扣除自身10000许愿值】
【请选择！】
content_en:
Yang Lu looked at the rejuvenating pill in his hand, his expression uglier than if he had eaten a fly.
He has lived for four hundred and seventy-six years, and the Five-Star Spiritual Emperor has reached the Great Consummation. Who in the entire Southwest Region cannot kneel down and shout "Lord Spiritual Emperor" when he sees him? As a result, now, a system appeared out of nowhere and forced him to take some kind of rejuvenation pill?
This thing sounds unreliable.
"System, are you sure there's nothing wrong with this elixir?" Yang Lu asked in his mind, "You won't have diarrhea after eating it, right? There won't be any side effects, right? You won't be able to change, right?"
The system did not respond.
Yang Lu waited for a while, and after confirming that the system really didn't want to pay attention to him, he gritted his teeth and threw the elixir into his mouth.
The elixir melts instantly in the mouth, and a cool medicinal power slides down the throat into the body, and then quickly spreads to the limbs and bones.
Yang Lu felt that his bones were making a slight "click" sound, his muscles were contracting, and his skin was tightening. Even his beard, which had lasted for three hundred years, was falling off at a speed visible to the naked eye.
"Fuck..."
Yang Lu looked down at his hands, which were originally covered with calluses and wrinkles, but were now becoming smooth, white, and young.
He quickly ran to the city wall and looked at his reflection on the water stains on the wall——
A face of eighteen years old.
Sword-like eyebrows and starry eyes, sharp edges and corners, and skin so white and tender that you can pinch water.
Yang Lu froze on the spot and stared for a long time before slowly exhaling: "This is me when I was young..."
This was what he looked like when he traveled through time.
Later, after experiencing countless battles, his face was weathered, and his body was scarred, he became that majestic five-star spiritual emperor.
It would be better now, once we return to before liberation.
【Mission completed! 】
[Rewards are being settled...]
[Breathe suppression ring x1 (distributed)]
[Wish value +500 (account balance: 1000)]
At the same time as the system prompt sounded, Yang Lu had a black ring in his hand.
The ring is completely black, without any patterns, and looks like an ordinary iron ring.
Yang Lu put the ring on the ring finger of his left hand, and a piece of information immediately poured into his mind——
[Breathe suppression ring (five-star spiritual weapon)]
[Function: After wearing it, the wearer's full strength aura will be suppressed until the two-star spirit king enters the spirit realm, without affecting the actual combat power]
[Remarks: This ring cannot be detected by any detection spell lower than five stars, and the existence of higher than five stars can detect clues]
Yang Lu raised his eyebrows slightly after reading the introduction.
This stuff is kind of interesting.
He tried to use the star power in his body, and sure enough, the aura emanating from his body was fixed at the two-star spirit king entering the spirit realm. Even if he deliberately released it, he could not break through this upper limit.
But when he actually took action, his five-star spiritual emperor strength was not lacking at all.
"It's a good thing to hide your strength." Yang Lu nodded, "I just don't know what the system is going to do..."
Before he finished speaking, the system prompt sounded again——
【New mission has been unlocked! 】
[1. Wear the aura suppression ring, go to the "Xinglan Sect" within the jurisdiction of Lingqian Peak, and join the sect as an ordinary inner disciple]
[2. Deduct 5,000 wish points from yourself]
[3. Deduct 10,000 wish points from yourself]
【Please choose! 】
Yang Lu: "..."
